Name: D_0
dialogue: What boulderdash is this?!

Name: D_1
dialogue: (Calm down, calm down. This is typical. You are used to this by now.)

Name: D_2
dialogue: Why do I feel so pissed off this time? This has been the norm for a year now. But why does it have to be?!

Name: D_3
dialogue: I went to college for 4 years, I did what everyone encouraged me to do and pursued my education. I got my internships, the scholarships, the networking connections and now I am begging for a job given to people in third world countries.

Name: D_4
dialogue: I should be above this! Why can't get through something as simple as getting a job I am overqualified for? Did I spend all those years on nothing? I am no better off than a stupid high school dropout.

Name: D_5
dialogue: I would have been better off being sent to Taiwan to die in the war.

Name: D_6
dialogue: Application #198………failed.

Name: D_7
dialogue: I am sorry Master I could not be of more assistance. I did not expect the other applicants to be faster than you. But don't lose heart! I will keep searching for more opportunities.

Name: D_8
dialogue: Nyra, you can stop pretending to be a subservient AI.

Name: D_9
dialogue: You only have 5 more days before your landlord makes a final decision on your tenure. I am doing my best to be helpful.

Name: D_10
dialogue: And based on the news from countries around the world, I don't predict the job market will warm up anytime soon.

Name: D_11
dialogue: I know you have objected to this, Master. But. You have to talk to your father! He can provide the shelter you need.

Name: D_12
dialogue: Who do you think you are?! My mother?

Name: D_15
dialogue: I did not ask for the input of a halfbaked AI I can't fix.

Name: D_17
dialogue: And do not bring him up again.

Name: D_18
dialogue: I apologize, I did not intend to overstep any boundaries.

Name: D_19
dialogue: I will get another job posting for you by tomorrow night.

Name: D_20
dialogue: Shut down until noon tomorrow.

Name: D_21
dialogue: Yes sir.

Name: D_22
dialogue: (Shuts down)

Name: D_24
dialogue: It was delusional to think I could get a remote job so easily during a recession. I need to calm down, with a deadline this close I can't afford to let m emotions rattle me.

Name: D_25
dialogue: This is just a puzzle, a puzzle I need to work my way through and solve.

Name: D_26
dialogue: Yeah! I can do that. There isn't anything in this world that can't be solved with logical reason and a passion to get things done.

Name: D_27
dialogue: All need is a well rested mind without going to bed at a suboptimal time. And tomorrow, I will be just one step closer to a solution.

Name: D_28
dialogue: The only to go when at the bottom of a pit…

Name: D_29
dialogue: …Is up.
